visa189ProcessSection.subtitle: Each step is clearly defined — RedBridge prepares your profile, Insight Idea handles the visa process.

0.title: Free Points Assessment
0.desc: We review your full profile and map out your points, competitiveness, and realistic pathway options.

1.title: Strategy Planning
1.desc: We identify the most impactful ways to improve your score, including English, experience or partner factors.

2.title: Skills Assessment Preparation
2.desc: We prepare your documents and application for ACS, AMI or other assessing bodies.

3.title: EOI Submission
3.desc: Your EOI is submitted with a strong, optimised profile ready for invitation rounds.

4.title: Visa Lodgement
4.desc: Once invited, your visa application is prepared and lodged by a registered migration agent.
